4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 1 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
OBJECTIVE:
Reset the SPICE Power/Video Unit firmware to return the SPICE display to normal (NOR)
mode in support of SLICE (Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiment). To do this, the
Power/Video Unit will be removed from MSG so the unit’s Video Titler Box can be opened to
scrape off conformal coating from circuit board pins (five of ten) to make temporary jumper
connections for advancing through the setup menu.
TOOLS:
8.5" Handrail, if needed
3" Common Tip Screwdriver, if needed
4 mm Hex Head, 1/4" Drive
Driver Handle, 1/4" Drive
Vacuum Cleaner
Fiberglass Stick P/N 182SO020 or Leatherman Tool, crew preference
ISS Pin Kit P/N SJG33110644-301
Pin to Socket Test Jumper Lead, 24 in. P/N SEG33112714-307 (five)
Static Wrist Tether
Fine Point Sharpie
D2Xs Camera
MATERIALS:
Kapton Tape
4X4 Ziplock Bag or equivalent
1. MSG/SLICE CONFIGURATION
1.1 Install 8.5" Handrail onto MSG Facility left seat track at position
G2 (if required).
CAUTION
Failure to remove the SAMS-II Seat Track Device/SE prior to Work
Volume extension could result in MSG and/or SAMS hardware
damage.
LAB1S2 1.2 Remove the SAMS-II Seat Track Device/SE from the top of the
MSG fwd seat track (upper left corner of MSG rack) by
loosening thumbscrews (two). Tmpry stow with cable still
attached.
1.3 While holding 8.5" Handrail with left hand, use right hand to:
Push knob, slide Core Facility to fully extended position, ensure
MSG Loading Ports are completely visible.
Pull knob (secure locking mechanism).
✓Core Facility Position securely locked
✓Each PDC LED – On (green)
1.4 ✓All operator rings, watches removed

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 2 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
1.5 Remove:
Left MSG Loading Port
Left, right front MSG Blank Glove Ring Assembly (two)
CMP 1.6 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
✓OUTLET1 +28V, +12V, +5V ON LED (three) – OFF
2. SPICE POWER/VIDEO UNIT REMOVAL
WV 2.1 Install lens cap on SPICE Video Camera Assembly.
2.2 Install lens cap on Still Camera.
2.3 Still Camera disconnections:
SPICE Feedthrough Cable P43 ←|→ SHUTTER J43
SPICE Power Cable P41 ←|→ J41
SPICE Still Camera Cable P42 ←|→ J42
2.4 Pull and hold plunger on Still Camera.
Remove Still Camera from SPICE Still Camera Mount and
temporarily stow.
2.5 Loosen fasteners (three) on the SPICE Still Camera Mount.
Slide the Still Camera Mount 2” left before lifting to avoid
damage to the SPICE Experiment Assembly.
Temporarily stow SPICE Still Camera Mount.
2.6 MSG W301 Video Extension cable disconnections :
P2 ←|→ VIDEO OUT J15 (SPICE Power/Video Unit)
P2 ←|→ STILLOUT J17 (SPICE Power/Video Unit)
2.7 SPICE Video Cable P14 ←|→ VIDEO IN J14 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit)
2.8 SPICE Still Camera Cable P16 ←|→ STILL IN J16 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit)
Temporarily stow SPICE Still Camera Cable.
2.9 SPICE Power Cable P1 ←|→ EXP. POWER J1 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit)
2.10 SPICE Feedthrough Cable P12 ←|→ SERIAL IN J12 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit) [3" Common Tip Screwdriver, if necessary]
2.11 Loosen fasteners (two) and remove SPICE Power/Video Unit
from WV rear wall.
2.12 SPICE Power/Video Unit P303 ←|→ EXP. OUTLET 1 J303 (WV
rear wall)
2.13 Remove SPICE Power/Video Unit from MSG WV.

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 3 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
NOTE
The SPICE Power/Video Unit consists of a Video Titler Box (right) and
a Power Conditioning Box (left) which are mounted on an aluminum
adapter plate.
3. SPICE POWER/VIDEO UNIT CHECK AND CONFORMAL COATING
REMOVAL
3.1 Setup ISS Vacuum near SPICE Power/Video Unit.
3.2 Don Static Wrist Tether
WARNING
The interior of the Video Titler Box was not intended to be accessed
during on-orbit operation and may contain sharp edges.
3.3 Remove the front cover of the Video Titler Box (SPICE
Video/Power Unit right side) and place non-captive fasteners
(two) in 4X4 Ziplock Bag [4 mm Hex Head, Driver Handle, 1/4"
Drive].
Use ISS Vacuum to suction loose particles, if needed.
3.4 Take 3 to 5 digital images of the Video Titler Box Circuit Board,
with focus on the firmware version label [D2Xs Camera].

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 4 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml

Figure 1. Video Titler Circuit Board

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 5 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
3.5 ✓POIC with firmware version, copyright date, confirm button
batteries present, and confirm conformal coating on 10-pin
connectors. (Refer to Figure 1)
If no conformal coating on 10-pin connectors,
Go to step 3.7

Figure 2. Pin Location
3.6 Remove conformal coating along the entire length of Pins 1, 2,
5, 6 and 8 [Fiberglass Stick or Leatherman Tool, crew
preference].
Refer to Figure 2.
Use ISS Vacuum to suction loose particles.
3.7 Label both ends of a Pin to Socket Test Jumper Lead with the
number 1 [Kapton Tape, Fine Point Sharpie].
Repeat with additional leads for number 2, 5, 6 and 8.
Refer to Figure 2.
3.8 If socket exteriors not insulated, apply Kapton Tape to socket
end of the Pin to Socket Test Jumper Lead.
Repeat for all Pin to Socket Test Jumper Leads.

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 6 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
3.9 Connect one end of each Pin to Socket Test Jumper Lead (five)
to its matching pin (1, 2, 5, 6 and 8).
Keep the pins separated so they do not touch each other.
4. SPICE POWER/VIDEO UNIT INSTALLATION
4.1 SPICE Power/Video Unit P303 →|← EXP. OUTLET 1 J303 (WV
rear wall)
4.2 Secure SPICE Power/Video Unit to WV rear wall:
SPICE Power/Video Unit A1 to WV rear wall B1
SPICE Power/Video Unit A2 to WV rear wall D1
4.3 SPICE Feedthrough Cable P12 →|← SERIAL IN J12 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit) [3" Common Tip Screwdriver, if necessary]
4.4 SPICE Power Cable P1 →|← EXP. POWER J1 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit)
4.5 SPICE Video Cable P14 →|← VIDEO IN J14 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit)
4.6 MSG W301 Video Extension cable P2 →|← VIDEO OUT J15
(SPICE Power/Video Unit)
MSG W301 Video Extension cable P2 →|← STILLOUT J17
(SPICE Power/Video Unit)
WV 4.7 Remove lens cap on SPICE Video Camera Assembly, place on
MSG Long Velcro Strip.
SPICE Exp.
Assy 4.8 SCALE lever → Push to hard stop
Video
Drawer 4.9 sw MAIN POWER → ON
✓MAIN POWER ON LED – On (green)
sw MONITORS 1,2 → ON
✓MONITORS 1,2 ON LED (two) – On (green)
sw CAMERAS 1,2 → ON
✓CAMERAS 1,2 ON LED (two) – On (green)
CMP 4.10 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
sw OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V → ON
✓OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V ON LED (three) – On (green)

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 7 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
5. JUMPER CONNECTIONS TO RETURN OVERLAY TO NOR MODE

Figure 3. MODE=HEX
NOTE
Continuous contact will quickly advance through menu. If advance past
desired selection, then simply cycle back to selection.
5.1 Make jumper connection for pin 6 and 2 (one simo momentary
connection) to enter titler setup menu.
✓MODE = HEX (displayed on MSG Video Monitor 1, Refer to
Figure 3)
***********************************************************************
If MODE=NOR
✓SAVE THIS SETUP = YES
Go to step 5.6
If SAVE THIS SETUP=NO
make jumper connection for pin 8
and 2 twenty-two times to scroll
through titler setup menu to select
SAVE THIS SETUP .
✓SAVE THIS SETUP is flashing
Go to step 5.5
**********************
***********************************************************************

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 8 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
5.2 Make jumper connection for pin 8 and 2 eight times to scroll
through titler setup menu to select MODE .
✓MODE is flashing

Figure 4. MODE=NOR
5.3 Make jumper connection for pin 5 and 1 (one simo momentary
connection).
✓MODE = NOR (Refer to Figure 4)
If SAVE THIS SETUP = YES
Go to step 5.6
5.4 Make jumper connection for pin 8 and 2 fourteen times to scroll
through titler setup menu to select SAVE THIS SETUP .
✓SAVE THIS SETUP is flashing
5.5 Make jumper connection for pin 5 and 1 (one simo momentary
connection) to select YES.
✓SAVE THIS SETUP = YES
5.6 Make jumper connections for pin 5 and 2 (one simo momentary
connection) to exit the titler setup menu.
SPICE-like display may be visible, but will likely be garbled.
CMP 5.7 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
sw OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V → Off

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 9 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
✓OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V ON LED (three) – Off (green)
5.8 Wait 30 seconds.
5.9 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
sw OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V → On
✓OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V ON LED (three) – On (green)

Figure 5. MSG Video Monitor displaying Flow Conditions
NOTE
SPICE does not drive the video overlay during the first 5 seconds,
during which time the data overlay might be garbled.
5.10 ✓MSG Video Monitor 1 has good digital data overlay of flow
conditions (Refer to Figure 5)
5.11 Repeat step 5.7through step 5.10two times to cycle power.
CMP 5.12 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
sw OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V → Off
✓OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V ON LED (three) – Off (green)
5.13 Remove Pin to Socket Test Jumper Lead (five) from SPICE
Power/Video Unit.
Trash Kapton Tape.
5.14 Install Video Titler Box front cover, secure with fasteners from
4X4 Ziplock Bag [4mm Hex Head, Driver Handle, 1/4" Drive].

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 10 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
5.15 Doff Static Wrist Tether.
6. MSG/SLICE RECONFIGURATION
WV 6.1 Install SPICE Still Camera Mount:
SPICE Still Camera Mount B1 to MSG cold plate B1
SPICE Still Camera Mount B2 to MSG cold plate B2
SPICE Experiment Assembly C1 to SPICE Still Camera Mount
6.2 Route all cables behind SPICE Still Camera Mount.
6.3 Install Still Camera onto SPICE Still Camera Mount.
✓Spring Plunger fully engaged (See Figure 7)
6.4 SPICE Power Cable P41 →|← J41 (Still Camera, right side)
SPICE Still Camera Cable P42 →|← J42 (Still Camera, right
side)
SPICE Still Camera Cable P16 →|← STILL IN J16 (SPICE
Power/Video Unit)
SPICE Feedthrough Cable P43 →|← SHUTTER J43 (Still
Camera, left side)
Tape SPICE Feedthrough Cable connection P43 to J43 [Kapton
Tape].
Tether Cables out of the camera field of view as necessary
using MSG Velcro Cable Ties.
6.5 Remove lens cap on Still Camera, place on MSG Long Velcro
Strip.
CMP 6.6 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
sw OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V → On
✓OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V ON LED (three) – On (green)
WV 6.7 Pull and hold plunger on Still Camera.
Remove Still Camera from SPICE Still Camera Mount.
6.8 Rotate Still Camera power switch → ON

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 11 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml

Figure 6. Still Camera Rear View
6.9 Set NEF (RAW) Recording to Lossless Compression:
pb MENU → Press (Figure 6)
✓SHOOTING MENU Screen is displayed
***********************************************************************
If SHOOTING MENU not displayed,
Select the SHOOTING MENU Screen
(UP/DOWN Multi-Selector (MS) Button)
Press the RIGHT MS Button to select.
*********
***********************************************************************
Highlight NEF (RAW) RECORDING (UP/DOWN MS Button).
pb RIGHT MS Button → Press (to select)
pb UP/DOWN → Press (to select TYPE)
pb RIGHT MS Button → Press (to select)
pb UP/DOWN → Press (to select LOSSLESS COMPRESSED)
pb OK → Press (to accept)

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 12 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml

Figure 7. METER Selection Switch
6.10 Rotate METER Selection Switch to middle position (Full
MATRIX).
See Figure 7.
6.11 Install Still Camera onto SPICE Still Camera Mount.
✓Spring Plunger fully engaged
SPICE
Control Box
Assy
6.12 pb SHUTTER → Press firmly and HOLD for 7 seconds.
6.13 Perform {2.007 SLICE FLASH CARD EXCHANGE}, steps 2-4
(US PODF: MSG SLICE)
CMP 6.14 EXPERIMENT POWER OUTLETS
sw OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V → Off
✓OUTLET 1 +5V, +12V, +28V ON LED (three) – Off (green)
6.15 Install:
Left MSG Loading Port
CMP 6.16 ✓HEALTH & STATUS WV PORTL LED – On (green)
✓HEALTH & STATUS WV PORTR LED – On (green)
6.17 sw FUNCTIONS AIR CIRC. → On

4.001 SPICE VIDEO OVERLAY RESET
(mgolall000251/IMPACT) Page 13 of
13 pages
1Feb12 MGUEMSGSLCEC001.xml
6.18 While holding 8.5" Handrail with left hand, use right hand to:
Push knob, slide Core Facility to retracted position.
Pull knob (secure locking mechanism).
✓Core Facility position securely locked
LAB1S2 6.19 Install the SAMS-II Seat Track Device/SE on the top of the
MSG fwd seat track (upper left corner of MSG rack) by
tightening thumbscrews (two).
7. FINAL STOW
7.1 Copy D2Xs images to SSC for downlink and notify POIC
7.2 Stow:
3" Common Tip Screwdriver
4 mm Hex Head, 1/4" Drive
Driver Handle, 1/4" Drive
4X4 Ziplock Bag
Fiberglass Stick, if used
Leatherman Tool,if used
ISS Pin Kit
Pin to Socket Test Jumper Lead (five)
ISS Vacuum
Static Wrist Tether
Fine Point Sharpie
D2Xs Camera
Kapton Tape

Table 2. Procedure Hazard Control List
Hazard Report Number Hazard Control Number Procedure Step(s)
STD-SLICE-01 14/14b.1 Go to step 1.6, step 5.12
MSG-G1 4/4.1 Go to step 1.6
MSG-G4 2/2.2 Go to step 1.3, step 6.18
